question: Should OpenClaw core accept model-proposed follow-up task suggestions as gateway-owned `spawn_task` and `dismiss_task` tools with Control UI accept/dismiss and managed-worktree session creation?
rationale: This adds new core model-tool, Gateway protocol, Control UI, and worktree-session product surface; current main does not implement it, and the protected `maintainer` label plus open closing PR mean automation should not resolve the direction.

options.title: Review the linked implementation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102422 as the canonical vehicle and decide there whether the product, permission, and worktree lifecycle shape is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow to design first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller protocol or product design before accepting the full UI and managed-worktree lifecycle.

options.title: Reject core scope
options.body: Close this issue and the linked pull request if model-proposed task suggestions should remain prose, subagents, or an external/plugin-owned workflow.

recommendation.title: Review the linked implementation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102422 as the canonical vehicle and decide there whether the product, permission, and worktree lifecycle shape is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the product request and the active implementation candidate, so they are the best available owner for the immediate direction decision.
